    What is HeraCARE?

    The digital transformation

    of maternity care

    HeraCARE is a cost-effective, end-to-end digital maternity monitoring and management platform. We make it simple and productive for providers to seamlessly integrate an innovative model of digital maternity care. HeraCARE increases capacity and safety while optimizing productivity gains and quality of care.

    What is HeraMED?

    Validated by global 
    medical leaders

    HeraMED is an innovative medical data and technology company leading the digital transformation of maternity care. We are reshaping the prenatal and postpartum experience through our revolutionary remote monitoring platform.

    Our technology is medically-validated and proven through multiple real-world implementations. It is the core that powers remote maternity care programs of some of the world’s most prestigious medical institutions.

    Simple set up

    We have designed a simple and effective implementation plan to get you up and running fast.

    Set up your cobranded ecosystem

    Optimize and assign relevant care plans and customer journies

    Configure your own rule base and thresholds with HeraCARE's smart messaging engine

    Increase capacity 
    & save time

    Put our technology to work. 
    Spend your time doing what you do best — caring for patients.

    Decrease in-person appointments by half and free up your capacity immediately

    Automatically deliver tasks including time based educational content and vital measurement performance

    Monitor out of range measurements via smart messaging in real-time

    HeraCARE Workflows

    Streamlined care 
    delivery

    Configurable, proactive, and effective, HeraCARE is a comprehensive solution for remote maternity care.
    From prescribing customizable care plans to actionable smart messaging, HeraCARE allows providers to easily monitor patient health in real time.

    Capturing vitals, prioritising out-of-range measurements, and managing patient adherence, all from a clean and intelligent care management dashboard. HeraCARE's smart messaging engine is built for management by exception, preventing alert fatigue and maximizing productivity.
